text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: A chunga kan tarlan ang hian, ”Eskimo” tih thumal hman hi United States ah chuan pawina awmlo mahse U S. pawn lam, a bik tak in Canada ah chuan mi tam tak in inhmuhsitna angin an ngai a ni.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Greenlandic Native te'n an tawngkam a an hman chu i hre maithei a, mahse a ram pawn mi te tan chuan hman ve hauh loh tur a ni.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Greenland khua leh tui dik takte chuan canada-ah Inuit tiin an inchhal a,Greenland ah chuan Kalaalleq (a tam sawi nan Kalaallit), Greenland a chengte tiin an inko .
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Sualna leh ram dang mi te laka helna hrim hrim pawh hi Greenland ah hian hmuh tur a awm meuh lo a. A khaw chhungah pawh hian "hmun hlauhawm" tia sawi tur a awmlo a ni.
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Khaw vawt chauh hi a inringlo tan chuan an thil hlauhawm tawn tur awmchhun chu a ni mai.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Greenland ram hi thlasik laia I tlawh a nih chuan (a hmar lampang I kal hnaihin a vawt telh telh ang), kawrlum tam tham tak i ken a tul dawn a ni.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Nipui lai hian ni a rei em avang hian duh ang thala mut hi a harsa thin a, mi pawh an hrisel loh phah fo.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Nipui lai hian Nordic thosi te lakah fimkhur ang che. Natna pe darh thei lo mahse, an ninawm duh phian.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: San Francisco ram economy chu an khualzin hip theihna nen inzawm mahse, an economy tak erawh hi chu a huam zau viau thung.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Inhlawhfakna tam theihna berte chu professional service te, sawrkar hna te, finance te, trade te leh tourism te an ni.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Rimawi, ennawm, thu leh hla leh hnam kalphung lar tak te a lan tam em avang hian a khawpui leh hmun pawimawh lai te hi khawvel pum hriat lar an nih phah a ni.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco khawpui hian khualzin hip theihna tur lian tak tak an siam a, hotel tam tham tak te, restaurant te, convention facility changkang tak tak te an nei a ni.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco khawpui pawh hi khawchhakho eitur siam ei nan pawh hmun tha tak a ni a, chungte chu: Korean te, Thai te, Indian te leh Japanese te an ni.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Walt Disney World a kal hi American chhungkaw tam tak tan chuan ram thianghlim tlawh ang maiin an ngai hlawm a ni.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: A tlawh dan "tlangpuiah" hi chuan Orlando International Airport a thlawh luh phawt a, a chhung Disney Hotel a bus a kal a, kar khat chhung Disney huam chhunga awm a haw leh hi a ni.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Theih dan chi hrang sawi sen loh a awm a, mahse heihi miten 'Disney World a kal' an sawi a a awmzia ber chu a la ni reng.
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Ticket tam tak online a lilamna website eBay emaw Craigslist kaltlang in vawikhat aia tam hman theih park-hopper ticket te hralh an ni bik.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Thil tihdan tlanglawn tak chu ni mahse, Disney chuan tih a khap ve thung: ticket te hi inhlan chhawn an theih loh a ni.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Grand Canyon hnuailamah eng ang camping atan pawh ram phalna lak hmasak a ngai.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Phalna pek chhuah zat bituk a awm chhan hi Canyon humhalh nan a ni a, a hma thla li intan hma, thlathar ni 1 ah phalna te chu lak theihin a awm.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Chuvangin, backcountry phalna May thla atana pekchhuahna chu January ni 1 aṭangin a lak theih ang.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Phantom Ranch hnaih mai a Bright Angel Campground ang chi hmun lar deuhah te chuan, a tlangpui thuin lehkha fill up nena ngenna hmangin hauh lawkna an hawn hmasak ber aṭang in hauh zawh nghal a ni thin.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Dilna nena a hmun a kal te tan hian phalna pek chhuah tur zât bituk a awm a,kal hmasa sa hnen ah pek ṭhin a ni.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Africa chhimlam car hmanga luh hi a chhehvel mawina leh khualzinte kal zen zen lohna kawng hmuhna atan a tha hle.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Hei hi car pangngai hmang pawhin fimkhur taka duan chuan a tih theih a, mahse 4x4 lirthei ngei hi chu keng a sual lo ang. Hmun hrang hrang tlawh tur hian 4x4 lirthei ke sang chi hi a ngaih vang a ni.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Kalna tur in duan laia rilrua awm tur chu South Africa ram hi ralmuang viau mahse, a ram thenawmte erawh hi chu an him vek lem lo a ni.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Visa mamawh dan chin leh insenso tur zat hi chu a ram kalna tur azir hian a danglam a, I rawn kalna ram azir te pawh a ni bawk.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Ram tin hian dan hran hran neiin car a ken tel tur rikrum thil lo thlen palh a awm chu a danglam ve zel a ni.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls hi Zimbabwe thlang lampanga khaw pakhat awm a ni a, Livingstone, Zambia leh Botswana hnaih te nen ramri a intawm a ni.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: A khua hi tuikhawhthla bul chiahah a awm a, khualzin te pawh a hip nasa hle. He hmun hian khualzin te tan a hmun vel fan leh ramchhuah theihna siamin an cham rei theih phah thin a ni.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Ruahsur nasat lai hi chuan (November atanga March), a tui san zawng hi a pun thin avang hian a Falls hi a lang pui thin em em a ni.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Leihlawn hi I zawh phei anih loh pawhin a kawngsir lama I kal phei chuan I huh ngei ngei dawn chiang sa.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: A lehlamah chuan, a tui awm zat hi a tam avang chiah hian a Falls I en theihna ber chu-a tui vek hian a dang daih dawn zuk nia!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Tutankhamun-a ruang zalhna (KV62). KV62 hi Valley a ruang zalhna hmun zingah chuan a lar ber angin a sawi theih a, a hmun hi Howard Carter-an kum 1922 a a hmuhchhuah atang khan lal naupang tak an zalhna hmun hi tihchingpen a lo la ni meuh lo a ni.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Lal chhungkaw dangte ruang an zalhna hmun nena tehkhin chuan Tutankhamun-a ruang zalhna hmun hi tlawh tlak a ni meuh lo a, a tet em avang leh han chei mawi em em a nih loh vang a ni.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: He ruang cheibawl hi an lakchhuah laia an tihchhiat dan hmuchiang duh te tan chuan hrilh a hai deuh maithei, a lu leh a dar vel chiah a lang thei tawh si a.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: A ruang zalhna hmuna rohlu chi hrang hrang dah te chu a awm tawh lo a, Cairo khawpuia Egyptian Museum ah sawn an ni vek tawh a ni.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Khualzin hun tam nei lo tan chuan a hmun tlawh hi a fuh ber lo maithei.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom hi Siem Reap chhimthlang atanga 12 km vela awm a ni. He tlang chunga biak in hi kum zabi 19 tawp lama sak kha a ni a, Lal Yasovarman-a lal lai a ni.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: A biak in chhehvel ngui em em leh Tonle Sap dil atanga khawthlir mawi tak avang hian a tlanga lawn hi a manhla em em a ni.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: A hmun hi I tlawh anih chuan lawng hmanga dil kal nen remchang takin I tikawp thei dawn a ni.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: A chhunga biak in tlawh tur hi chuan Angkor Pass a ngai a, chuvang chuan Tonle Sap lam I kal chuan I passport ken theihnghilh miah suh ang che.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jerusalem hi Israel ramah chuan a khawpui ber a nih mai bakah khawpui lian ber a ni bawk, nimahsela khawvel ram tam zawk leh United Nations hian Israel khawpui angin an pawmpui ve lo.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Judean Hills a khawpui hlui tawh tak hi kum sang tam tak sulhnu sawi tur a nei a ni.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: A khawpui hi pathian pakhat ring sakhaw pathumte tan hmun thianghlim a ni a, chungte chu - Judaism, Kristianna leh Islam te niin, thlarau leh sakhaw thilah hmun pawimawh tak a ni.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Sakhaw kaihhnawih thil vanga hmun pawimawh a nih em avang hian, Old City a hmun tam tak phei hi chu a bik takin an lar a, khualzinte tana tlawh pawhna hmun ber a nih phah bawk a ni.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jerusalem hian hun kal tawh te, hmasang chanchin zirna leh hnam zia lantirna kawnga hmun pawimawh te a nei ngah em em a, chu mai bakah bazarna hmun lun nuam tak te, café leh restaurant te pawh a nei nual a ni.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ecuador ram chuan Cuba ram mipuite chu international airport leh frontier admission point hmanga Ecuador an lut duh anih chuan sawmna lehkhathawn an neih a ngaih thu a chhuah a ni.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: He lehkhathawn hi Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs in a pawmpui a ngai a, phutna hrang hrang an zawm a ngai bawk a ni.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Heng phutna te hi ram leh ram inkara mumal taka pemna a awm theih nana siam an ni.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Cuba ram mipui zingah US green card nei an awm chuan Ecuadorian Consulate an pan a ngai a, hemi phutna awltir bik theih nan an pan a ngai a ni.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: I passport chu I zin zawh hnua thla 6 thleng tal a dam tur a ni. I cham hun tur finfiah nan round/onward trip ticket I mamawh bawk ang.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Zinvahna chu mi an tamin a tlawm zawk a, chuvang chuan nangmah chauh I ni emaw I thian pakhat nen chauh in nih chuan midang bulah kal tum ngei ngei ula, a tlawm theih nan mi pali emaw paruk tal nih tum ang che u.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Amaherawhchu, thil ngaihtuahawm a nih ve tho a ngai, khualzinte hi car hran hrana dah kual an nih thin avangin.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Hetiang thil hi chu mi bum na mai a ni a, an pek tur aia tam an pek theih nana ti an ni thin.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Machu Picchu hmar tawp lamah hian he tlang awih tak hi a awm a, ruins te thla an lak hian a hnungah a lo lang un zel a ni.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: A hnuai lampang atanga en phei chuan a tihawm em em a, awih tak leh har taka lawn ngai niin, mihring hrisel tha pangngai tan chuan minute 45 velah a thlen theih ang.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Lung step te hi kalna turah dah an ni hlawm a, a awih zualpui lai velah phei chuan thir hrui dah niin a invawn phei theih a ni.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Chutiang a ni na chungin, a awih zualpui laiah chuan thaw khamloh I inrin a ngai tho, a bik takin a hmun a huh phei chuan tluk sual a hlauhawm em em a ni.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: A chhip bulah hian puk te tak te kal tlang tur a awm a, a hniamin a chhung hi a chep em em a ni.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Galapagos a chhehvel leh nungchate hmu chiang tur hi chuan lawng hman a fuh ber a, Charles Darwin-an kum 1835 a a tih ang chiah kha a ni.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Veivahna lawng 60 chuang zet hi chu Galapagos tuiah hian an awm reng a - a len zawng hi a chuangtu 8 atanga 100 phur thei te an ni.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Mi tam zawk hian a hmun hi a hma atang tawhin an lo hauh lawk thin (lawngte hi a hunlai tak tak chuan an khah zung zung vang a ni).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: I hauh lawk ve dawn anih chuan I hauhna te kha Galapagos hrechiangtu leh a chhehvela thil hriat ngai leh lawng awm dan hre tak an ni ngei tur a ni.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Hei hian duhzawng bik emaw inkhuahkhirhna bik I neih dan azira lawng I chuanna tur taka I chuan theih tur a tichiang ngei ang.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Spain mite kha kum zabi 16 na laia an rawn thlen hma khan, Chile hmar lam hi Inca te awpbehna hnuaiah awmin Araucanian hnamte (Mapuche) chu Chile laili ah leh chhim lamah an awm thung.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuche hnamte hi America ram leilunga awm sa hnam hnuhnung ber pawl niin, Spain mite hnuaia awm hman lo chiah chiahin Chile chuan zalenna an chang hman a ni.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Chile ram hian kum 1810 khan zalenna puang mahse (Napoleonic indona kara Spain in sawrkar mumal kum engemawzat chhung a neih loh karah), Spanish laka hnehna chiang tak chu kum 1818 khan a nei chauh a ni.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Dominican Republic (Spanish:República Dominicana) hi Caribbean ram a ni a,Hispaniola thliarkar khawchhak lam chanve, Haiti nen a an inṭawm chu a awh a ni .
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Tuipui kam a ṭiauvut var sar leh tlâng mawi tak te bakah hian he ram hi Americasb-a European khawpui hlui ber te luah khah ram a ni a, tunah chuan Santo Domingo peng pakhat a lo ni ta a ni.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: He thliarkar hi Tainos leh Caribes ten an luah hmasa ber a,Caribes te hi Arawakan ṭawng hmang tute an ni a, kum 10,000 BCE a rawn thleng ni a hriat an ni.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: European ram thar zawng tute rawn thlen aṭanga hun reilote chhûngin Tainos mipui te chu Spanish hnehtute chuan langtham khawpin an tihtlemsak a.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Fray Baetolomé de las Casas(Tratado de las Indias) te sawi danin, kum 1492 leh 1498 inkar khan Spainish te khân Taínos mi 100,000 zet an that ni a hriat a ni.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. He hmun awl hi kum zabi 17 na a sakhaw rawngbawltu hmeichhe awmkhawmna atrium atan sak a ni a, heng insak zingah hian Templo de San Diego hi ala ding awmchhun a ni.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Tunah chuan central plaza anga hman a ni tawh a, chhun leh zan engtiklai pawhin thil thleng a awm reng a ni.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: A huan hi restaurant engemawzatin a hual vel a, chhunah leh tlaiah te hian central gazebo atang hian concert a thlawna en theih tur an siam thin.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Bathlar pahnihte chu 69 centimetre lekin a inthen a, hmanlai hmangaihna thawnthu awmna hmun a ni.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Cheng thir engemawzat lekin naupangte chuan a thawnthu chu an hrilh thei ang che.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Bowen Island hi kalna hmun lar tak leh chawlhkar chhunga kal chhuahna tha tak a ni a, kayak te, hiking te, dawr te leh restaurant chi hrang hrangte a awm vek a ni.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: He khawtlang hi Howe Sound ah awmin Vancouver hnu lawkah a awm a, downtown Vancouver a Greenville Island chhuahsan water taxi hmangin awlsam takin a tlawh theih a ni.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Pawnler lam thiltih ngaina mi I nih chuan, Sea to Sky corridor kal hi I tih ngei ngei a ngai.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler( Vancouver atanga motor hmanga darkar khat leh a chanve kal) chu luah hawh man to hle mah se 2010 Winter Olympics vangin hriat a hlawh hle.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Thlasikah North America-ah vur tawlhin hun nuam tak lo hmang la, nipuiah thirsakawr hmanga tlang fan kualna (mountain biking) lo hmang bawk rawh le.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Hmun thenkhat, Sirena-ah te chuan kal phalna permit dil lawk a ngai a, zana riak tur phei chuan permit neih ngei a ngai a ni.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena hi ranger station zinga camping chauh ni lo, riahna leh eitur awm nghalna awm chhun a ni. La Leona, San Pedrillo leh Los Patos te chuan eitur an chhawpchhuak ve lo a ni.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Park luh phalna permit hi Puerto Jiménez-a Ranger Station-ah dil theih a ni a, credit card erawh an pawm lo.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Park Service (MINAE) chuan park luh phalna permit hi park kal hma thla khat aia tam hmain a pe chhuak ngai lo.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol chuan ni khat luh man atan US$30 emaw $10 in reservation service a pe thei a, anmahni Corcovado page-ah en chian theih a ni.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Cook Islands hi thliarkar awm khawm ram a ni a, New Zealand nen inkungkaihna tha tak nei, South Pacific Ocean-a Polynesia-a awm a ni.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: He hmun hi thliarkar 15 lai awm khawm niin, 2.2 maktaduai km2 a zau, tuipui chheh vela inpharh duah mai a ni.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Hawaii nen time zone khat intawmin, mi thenkhat chuan he island hi "Hawaii down under" niin an lo ngai thin bawk.
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Hawaii aiin te zawk mah se, he island hian kum upa lam ho chu Hawaii state-a chhiar a nih hma, tourist hotel leh hmasawnna lian tak tak awm hma a hriatchhuahtir fo a ni.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Cook Islands hian khawpui a nei hranpa lova, amaherawhchu island hrang hrang 15 a huam tel thung. Rarotong leh Aitutaki te hi island 15 zinga mi an ni.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Tunlaiah chuan khawlvela ram changkang zawkte chuan zan riahna hmun nuam tak leh eitur tuihnai tak chhawpchhuah hi tih dan berah an nei chho zel tawh a ni.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: B&B ho inelna ber chu mikhualte zan riahna leh tukthuan tuihnai tak chhawpchhuah a ni ber mai.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Hetiang hmun lianah hi chuan thil engkim a changkang hle a, mutbu nuam tak mithemthiam kutchhuak ngat a nih loh pawhin khum lian leh ropui takte an nei fur hlawm a ni.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: An tukthuan chhawpchhuah chu an awmna hmun leh a hunlai azira a tui thei ang ber a ni tlangpui a, hmun thenkhatah chuan a neitute eitur siam chhuanvawr bik an chhawpchhuak thin bawk.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Heng hmun lian innghahna leilung hi building hlui leh hlutna ropui tak neite an ni thin a, a inchhung thilah pawh hlutna tam tak nei bik riau chauh an hmang a, an hmunte chu a hnum hlarh bakah swimming pool an nei tlangpui a ni.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Mahni motor ngei han khalh chhuah a hawi thawveng tura hmun hla tak pan vang vang hi ho tham ang takin lang mah se nawmna riau a nei ve tlat a ni.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Motor lian dangte ang lo takin mahni motor ngei han khalh chhuah hi chu a chinchang leh tlan theih chin hrechiang bertu kan ni.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Mimal ram emaw hriat ngai loh khuaa awmna tur buk sak ve ngawt hian buaina a thlen ve thei a ni.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Mahni motor-a han feh chhuah hi hawi thawvenna tha tak chu ni mah se "camp dan tur" dik takah ngaih a ni lem lo.
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Motor hmanga camp nei tur hi chuan motor lian lampang, van emaw SUV, Sedan leh Station Wagon emaw neih a ngai a, heng motor lian ho hi a thutna tihtlukin mutna atan hman nghal theih a ni.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Hotel thenkhat chuan golden age hunlaia rel leh lawng lian ropui tak ni thinte atanga an thil hlu neihte an pholang thin a, heng thil hlui hlu tak takte hi Indopui Pahnihna (kum zabi 19-na emaw 20-na) lai vela mi an ni tlangpui thin.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Heng hotel-ah te hian mi hausa ber berte an thleng thin a, eitur tuihnai tak tak eiin zan lamah hun nuam tak an hmang bawk thin a ni.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: An thil hlui ngaihsannate hian ti lar zualin, tunlai changkanna tharin a tihbuai lohna hmun siam hi an thil tum ber a ni.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Heng hmunte hi mimal ta ni thin mah se sawrkar lam leh thil danga mi thiltithei tak takte pawhin thlen nan an hmang thin a ni.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Zin mi hausa deuh chuan khawvel fan kual paha heng hotel lian leh changkang tak taka thlen zeuh zeuh hi a tih dan a ni.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Hospitality exchange network an tih mai hi zin mite leh an zinna tur hmuna awmte inkungkaihna tha tak siamna hmanrua a ni.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Heng hmaruate hi hmang ve thei tur chuan awlsam taka online-a form thehluh mai a tawk a; amaherawhchu hmun thenkhatah chuan finfiahna tha tawk tak dah tel a ngai thin bawk.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Form thehluh fel hnuah hian hotel chi hrang hrang awmna list an lo thawn a, a chang chuan a thleng tawhte ngaihdan leh fakselna an rawn thawn tel thin bawk.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing hi kum 2004 January atanga rawn lar chhuak a ni a, a lar chhan ber pawh computer lam thiam Casey Fenton-an Iceland zin tura thlawhtheihna ticket man tlawm a hmuh hnu pawha chamna tur a hmuh zawh loh vanga a kal theih tak loh vang a ni.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: A zinna tura university zirlai ho a be pawp hlauh a, anni chuan a thlawna awm lailawkna tur tam tak an lo kawhhmuh a ni.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Hostel chuan kum lama naupang lam chauh tan awmna tur an buatsaih thin a, a tlangpuiin kum 20 hnuailam hret emaw chunglam hret an ni thin a, amaherawhchu puitling khualzin pawh hmuh tur an awm fo a ni.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Chhungkua a naupang nena zin hmuh tur awm khat viau mah se, hostel thenkhat chuan private room-ah awm an phalsak thin a ni.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Beijing khawpui China ami chuan 2022-a Winter Olympics a thleng dawn a, hei hian Beijing khawpui hi Winter Olympics leh Summer Olympics thleng kawp hmasa bertu a nihtir dawn a ni.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing hian a hawnna leh kharna inkhawm a thlen dawn mai bawkah vur kaihhnawih infiamna (indoor ice events) a thleng dawn bawk a ni.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Vura tawlh leh vur lama infiamna thenkhat chu Taizicheng ski area ah neih a ni dawn a, he hmun hi Beijing atanga 220 km a hla Zhangjiakou-ah a awm a ni.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Temple tam zawk chuan kum tin hian inthhlimna an nei thin a, hei hi temple calender azirin a danglam thei a, a then chuan November atanga May thla laihlawl thleng a awh a ni.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Temple a intihhlimna huaihawtte hi a temple din champha lawmna emaw, a temple-a pathian awm pian champha emaw a temple tana ni pawimawh hrim hrim lawmna a ni tlangpui.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Kerala-a temple intihhlimna huaihawt hi a hmuhnawm thei em em a, mawi taka chei sai inzui duah duahte, zaipawl ropui tak takte leh intihhlimna chi hrang hrang a keng tel thin.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: World Fair ti a hriat lar (World Exposition emaw Expo ti a koh bawk) hi khawvel huap festival lian a ni a, arts leh science lam kaihhnawih intawhkhawmna hunpui a ni.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: A tel tur ramte chu anmahni ram thil theuh phochhuahna tur an siam saka, ram hrang hrangte chuan anmahni ram history leh culture, zirna leh hriatzauna atana pawimawh tur ni a an hriatte an rawn pho chhuak thin a ni.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: International Horticultural Exposition hi thlai leh pangpar chi hrang hrang pho chhuahna bik a ni a, pangpar mawi tak takte, par nei kher lo pawh thlai hring lam hrim hrim pho chhuahna a ni.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Sawi mai chuan kum tina huaihawt theih tura ngaih a ni a (ram hrang hrang ami an nih phawt chuan), amaherawhchu a takramah chuan kum tin neih theih a ni lo a ni.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Heng puipunnate hian thla thum atanga thla ruk chhung hun a awh tlangpui a, hmun a mamawh zauvin hectare 50 aia te lo mamawh tlangpui a ni.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Kum kalta chhung zawng khan film siam dan chi hrang hrang a awm tam hman hle a. 35mm film (36 by 24mm negative) hi an hman hluar ber a ni.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Hman zawh hunah awlsam takin a neih leh mai theih a, a fiah zawng pawh tunlaia an hman lar DSLR nen a inhlat lo hle a ni.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Medium-format film camera thenkhat chuan 6 by 6cm format an hmanga, sawi chianna atan 56 by 56mm negative a tih theih bawk.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Hei hian thlalak chu 35mm negative(3136 mm2 versus 864) aiin a let liin a tifiah zawk a ni.
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Nungchate thla lak hi thla laa ei zawng tan chuan thil huphurhawm tak a nihna lai a awm a, thlalak nalh tak tak nei tur chuan vanneihna eng emaw takte, dawhtheihnate leh hmanraw tha tak tak a neih a ngai a, zei ve hrim hrim leh tih thante pawh a ngai thin viau.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Nungchate thlalak hian ngaihpawimawh a hlawh lem lo fo thina, amaherawhchu thlalak dang ang thoin pakhat chauh pawh hian thil tam tak a sawifiah thei a ni.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Nungchate thla la tur hian lens sei bik telephoto lens an tih mai hi hman a ngai a, sava leh nungcha te tham tak tak thla la tur phei chuan lens chi dang a ngai leh daih thung.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Ramsa dangdai tam zawk hi chu an vangin hmuh an har em em a, park thenkhatah chuan pawisa lakluhna tura thla laksak dawnin dan leh dun fel tak zawm tur an siam a ni.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Ramsate hi a then an tit viau laiin a then chu kawlh thei hle a. An awmna hmun pawh a ramsa azirin a lum viau emaw vawt viau thei bawk a, a hlauhawm thei tlangpui bawk.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Khawvelah hian tawng chi hrang 5000 chuang a awma, heng zinga tawng 20 ai tam hi chuan tawng hmangtu maktaduai 50 aia tam a nei a ni.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Thuziak hi tawngkaa sawi aiin hriatthiam a awl zawk thin a. A bik takin chenna veng hming lam har tak takte hi ziakin hriatthiam a awl zawk a ni.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Ram thenkhatah chuan ram mipuiten sap tawng (English) an thiam em em a, kum lama naupang deuh phei chuan sap tawng chungchang an hre nual bawk a ni.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Mancunia mi, Boston mi, Jamaica mi leh Sydneyside mi, Toronto-a thingpui dawr a thu ho han suangtuah chhin la.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Anmahni awmna hmun theuh chanchin chu anmahni tawng dan theuhin chhuang takin an lo sawi khawm liam liam a.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Bazar liana eitur lei mai hi a tlawm thei ang bera inhnawhpuarna tha tak a ni a. Mahni rawng bawl chawpna tur hmanrua neih miau loh chuan ready-made lei mai loh chu tih dan a awm lo a ni.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Heng bazar liante hian ready-made eitur zawrhna bik an siam hrang thluah tawh a. Hmun thenkhatah phei chuan eitur tihlum nghal theihna tur microwave oven an chhawp tel bawk thin a ni.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Ram thenkhatah chuan heng dawr lianahte hian thil ei nghal theihna tur restaurant a awm tel tlangpui a, restaurant changkang tak ni lem lo, man vantlang taka thil ei theihna an ni hlawm.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Mahni insurance biak pawh theihna number hi ah mai theih tura awlsama siam tur a ni.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Insurance company atanga pawisa dawng tur leh rawtna chi hrang hrang dawng turin an e-mail leh international phone number a ngai thin a ni.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Mahni bag-ah copy khat emaw neih a tha a, online-a dahthatna chi hrang hrangah awlsam taka en theih tura dah tur a ni.
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Laptop emaw tablet nen kan zin anih chuan internet hman kher ngai loa en mai theihna turah dah that bawk tur a ni.
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Heng insurance company policy leh biak pawh theihna number hi kan zinpuite emaw in lama kan chhungte pawh kan kawltir tur a ni.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Moose ti a an sawi sakhi lian chi hi a hranpa a mi beih ching chu ni lo mah se, dinhmun derthawnga awm ni a an inhriat chuan mihring pawh beih an hreh lo a ni.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Heng sakhi liante hi mi tam takin hlauhawm loha an ngaih avangin an hnaih lutuk thin a, hei hian dinhmun hlauhawm takah a dintir ta thin a ni.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Intur ruihtheih lam chi chu insum theih nise.Zu hian mi zawng zawng a khawih dan a inanglo, i in theih chin hriat a pawimawh hle.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Zu in nasat vanga hriselna rei tak ti khawlo thei natna zingah hian tin thalo te, mitdelna leh thihna hial te pawh hi a tel a ni.Dan phalloh a siam zu in te tan hiana hlauhawm lehzual.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Dan phalloh a siam zu fir te hian bawlhhlawh hlauhawm tak tak a pai a chung ah te chuan methanol, tlemte in pawha mitdelna emaw thih hial thlen thei hi a tel a ni.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Tarmit te hi ram pawnah a tlawm zawk thin, a bik takin pawisa lakluhna hniamna ram hlawhfa tlawm taka an chhawrna ah te hian.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Inah i mit entir dawn ta la, a bik takin i insurance in a huam chin, a hnuah daktawr lehkha kha hmundangah ziah khah turin keng ta la.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Brand lar tak hming hetiang hmuna a awm chuan buaina pahnih a awm thei; a then chu a lem a ni thei a, a tak pawn atanga lak luh a awm pawhin in ram aiin a man a to thei.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Coffee hi khawvel a zawrhsum indawrtawn nasat ber te zing ami a ni, a chi dang dang te pawh in ramchhungah i hmu thei ngei ang.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Nimahsela, khawvel ah hian coffee in dan danglam tak tak in chhin manhla tak te a tam hle.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Canyoning (emaw: canyoneering) hi kawr thuk tak mawng a luh a ni a, a ro emaw tui tamtak awmna pawh a ni thei.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Canyoning hian tui hleuh te, lawn te leh zuan lam te a huam a -- mahse tan tir chuan inzir emaw taksa pianhmang in a zir phawt a ngai (entirnan, rockclimbing, scuba diving emaw alpine skiing te nena khaikhin chuan).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Tlang lawn hi pawnlam a chet tlat zing ami chuchuan ramhnuai boruak a ke a kal te a keng tel a, tlang lawnna kawngah te a ni fo.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Chhun a tlang lawn zingah hian mel khat tling lo atanga a ai thui deuh nikhat a kal chhuah theih a tel a ni.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Chhun a tlang lawn awlsam deuh ah hian inpuahchahna tlem tal a ngai, mi inthazo pangngai tan chuana nuam tawk hle.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Chhungkua naupang tete nei tan chuan inpuahchah nasat a ngai llehzual, mahse pawnlam a nikhat lek hman hi chu naute leh pre-school zirlai nen pawh a awlsam hle.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Rampawn bikah chuan, tlan pah a hmun fang pawl 200 dawn lai a awm.A tam zawk chu mahni a in relbawl an ni.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Khawvel pumhuap a tlan pah a hmun fang pawl rochuntu, Go Running Tours chuan tlan pah a hmun fang puitu mi dawrzawn khat khawmualpui pali ah a zar pharh.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Barcelona a Barcelona Running Tours a zung kaih leh Copenhagen a Running Copenhagen te chu, rang takin Running Tours Prague Prague leh hmundang a innghat te chuan an zawm.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Khawiah emaw i zinchhuah hma leh zinchhuah hnu hian thil tamtak ngaihtuah hmasak a ngai a ni.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: I zinchhuah in, "in ang chiah" a nih beisei suh. Chet phung, dan te, chaw, veivahna, rei lo te chenna, tehkhawng, tawng leh thildang tam tak te kha i chenna hmun ami ang a ni lo thei.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Heihi i rilru a i dah reng a ngai, a ram mite chet dana lungawi lohna emaw duhlohna lantir hi pumpelh hram tur a ni.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Khuazin buaipuitute hi kum zabi 19-na lai vel atang tawh khan an awm tawh a.Khualzin buaipuitu rawih hi zinna a thil tihchi tak khualzin te ai a leilung dan kalhmang, hnam kalphung,tawng lama tawnhriat ngah emaw lakluh tlem vang te'n.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Heng buaipuitu te hian hauh lawk an phal tlangpui a, ni mahse heng buaipuitu tamtak te hian zin dan bik chi dang dang an thiam hle, sum dinhmun a zir in emaw
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Buaipuitu in zin tawhna a i zin rualpui fo hman pawh a tha ber ang.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Heng buaipuitute hian eng zin khawthawnna nge an fak deuh tih an website ah emaw shop window ah te en ang che.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Tlawm zawk, loh theih loh, nundan emaw chona avanga khawvel fankual i duh a nih chuan, tihtheih dan a awm.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: A bul berah chuan, chihnih in an awm a: zin laia hnathawh emaw pawisa hman tihtlem.He thuziak hi chuan a hnuhnung zawk hi a thlur bing mah.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Nawmsakna hlan ngam te tan, hun leh rin dik theihna in hmanral zat chu bial ah a tihniam thei, zinna atana senso hnaim thri ang ber a ni.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: An finchhuahna atang chuan khualzinte hian ruk an ru lo a, dan phalloh a sumdawnna ah an telo a, kut an dawhlo a, emaw an hlawk nan midang an hmang heklo.

text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Map hranpa lei ngai lo in GPS hian pawisa mi dahthatsak a, a GPS mal ang tawp a nih loh pawhin car hawhna company ah te hian a awm vek tawh a ni.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: I phone ah data connection I neih loh chuan, emaw signal awmlohna hmuna I awm anih chuan, an tangkaina hi a tlahniam ve in a awmlo hmak thei tho bawk a ni.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Kil tina dawr awmah hian mak tak maiin pawisa pek tawh sa hmangin phone card a lei theih a, hei hi phone hman hawhna hmunah te leh telephone pangngaiah pawh an hman theih vek a ni.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Card tam tak hmang hian khawi atang pawhin call a siam theih rualin, a then ve thung hi chuan kan ram va biak tur azirin a man tlawm zawkin call an siam thei bawk.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Hetiang ang hman theihna hi call man awmlo telephone number atangin a ni tlangpui a, eng phone hmang pawhin an call theih a ni.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Thlalak naran tura dan siamte chu video lakah pawh a huam a, a huam zau zawk tih hial theih khawp a ni.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Thil mai mai thlalak pawh phal loh anih chuan, video a lak ngat phei chu a ngaihtuah pawh ngaihtuah suh ang che.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Drone I hman dawn chuan, I lak hmain I lak theih chin tur te hre phawt la, thil la tura permit leh licensing dang ngai te pawh hriat vek tum ang che.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Airport bulah emaw mipui tamna chunga drone thlawhtir hi thil tihchi a ni vak lo a, thil phal loh a ni lo a nih pawhin tih loh a him ber ang.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Tunlaiah chuan thlawhtheihna hmanga kan zin duh a nih chuan hmun danga a ticket man te en phawt loh chuan a airline hmanga hauh lawk hi an ti ngai tawh meuh lo.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: A chang chuan a thlawhtheihna inang rengah pawh a chuanna man hi a zuartu azirin a danglam thei em em a, chuvang chuan website hrang hranga a man en kual phawt hi a man tlawm ber hmuh nan chuan a tihchi ber a ni.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Ram thenkhatah hi chuan reilote zin nan chuan visa I mamawh dawn lo a, chumi nilo a lehkha zir tur te a I cham char char dawn anih chuan, khualzin veivak tur mai mai ai chuan I mamawh rei zawk daih ang.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: A tlangpuiin, rei tak chhung ram danga cham I tum anih chuan visa hi I kal hmain I neih sa daih tawh a ngai ang.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Zirlai visa te hian khualzinte leh sumdawn thila zinte visa ai chuan mamawhna dang bik hi a nei thin tlangpui.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Ram tam tak tan chuan, I zir duhna hmun atanga offer letter dawn hi an phut thin a, chu mai lo pawh kum khat chhung nangmahin I in chawm zo dawn a ni tih finfiahna te thlengin an duh thin bawk a ni.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: A zirna hmun te nen inbe chiang ula, a rama immigration department te hnenah pawh thil hriattur pawimawh dang zawh chian a tha khawp ang.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Palai te I nih lem loh chuan, tuipui ral piah lam daiha hnathawh chu I ram awmna azirin income tax te pawh I chawi a ngai tel dawn tihna a ni.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Income tax te hi a ram azirin a pek dan tur kawng a danglam ve hret hret a, chhiah pek tur bituk zat te leh bracket te hi a ram azirin a danglam bawk a ni.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Ram tangrual thenkhatah chuan, entirnanah United States leh Canada ah te, income tax te hi sawrkar lam leh a khaw mi te tan ve ve a hrangin siam a ni a, chuvang chuan chhiah pek tur zat hi awmna a zirin a danglam zel thei a ni.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Immigration endikna hi nangma ram a nih tawh hi chuan an ti a nih pawhin a hming lek hi a ni thin a, customs endikna erawh hun duh rei tak a ni viau thung.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: I ken theih thil leh theihloh thil te chu hrechiang phawt la, a ken theih zat thlengin hre vek ang che.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Khualzinna chungchang ziah hmanga eizawn bultanna awlsam ber chu mawi taka I ziah theih nana zinna blog website neih phawt hi a ni.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Web hmanga duh ang thala format leh edit I thiam hunah, nangma website pawh ila siam thei maithei asin.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Zin laia mahni duh thua thil thawh hi danglamna tha siam thei a ni a, amaherawhchu a thlawna inpek char char lam erawh a kawk lem lo.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Ram danga awm leh tlawmngaia thiltih hi a awmna hnam ziarang hriatna kawng tha tak a ni a, mahni inhriatchianna te, kan khawthlir tihzau nan te leh thiam thar neih nan te a tangkai hle.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Hetianga awm hi kan pawisa neihsa a aia rei zawk cham theih nana daih rei tir nan te pawh a tha em em a, hetiang ang a mahni duh thua thawh hi room te an pek mai bakah a hlawh hi an pek chhiat ngai em em loh vang a ni.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Viking hnam te chuan Russia a tui kalna te chu Black Sea leh Caspian Sea kal nan an hmang thin a.Heng kalna hmun thenkhat te hi tun thleng pawh hian hman theih a la ni bawk.I kal duh chuan permit bik a ngai nge ngai lo tih enfiah la, a lak erawh a harsa deuh maithei.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: White Sea-Baltic tui kawng hian Baltic tuipui leh Arctic tuifinriat a zawmtir a, Lake Onega atang te, Lake Ladoga atang te leh Saint Petersburg atang tein lui leh dil hmangin a pawh a ni.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Lake Onega pawh hian Volga a va zawm a, chuvangin Caspian tuipui atanga Russia ram kal hi a la theih tho a ni.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Marina I thlen meuh chuan rinhlelh theihloh khawpin I chiang uarh mai ang.Lawng zin mek dangte pawh I hmu a nga, anni in I hriat duh ang ang chu an hrilh theih ang che.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: A awmzia berah chuan mi I tanpui thei a ni tih notice chu I tar kual a nga, lawng chawlhna hmunah chuan vak kual velin, anmahni lawng sil mek mite chu I va pan a nga, lawng mi te nena inbiakpawh tum te, leh a dang dang te.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Mi a tam thei ang ber biak tum ngei ngei ang che.A hnu deuhah mi zawng zawngin an hria che a nga, eng lawng berin nge mite zawng tih insih hmuhna I hmu ngei ang.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: I Frequent Flyer airline chu alliance ah fimkhur takin I thlang tur a ni.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: I airline thlawh thanna han zawm mai chu thil tih awm reng angin a lang maithei a, nimahsela I hriat tel tur chu, voh bik thil tam tak hi a airline a zirin a dang ve zel a, frequent flyer points te pawh duhsak bik te an lo awm lehzel bawk a, hetiang thil hrang hrang hi ngaihtuah tel a fuh a ni.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Airline thenkhat, Emirates tih te, Etihad Airways tih te, Qatar Airways tih te leh Turkish Airlines tih te hi chuanin mipui tana an thawhna hi Africa khawmualpui bikah hian an tichak thar nasa em em a, Africa khawpui lian tak tak te pawh zawm tuah tangin European airline te aiin a man pawh an tihniam thei deuh zawk a ni.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Kum 2014 chhung khan Turkish Airlines hi Africa ram 30 a hmun 39 ah lai a thlawk kual a ni.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: I zin laiin hun awl I neih chuan, Africa a zinna man hi khawvela a zin kualna man nen a inthlau viau em tih I en dawn nia.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Visa mana i insenso zat turte chhut theihnghilh lo a, a chhuahna tur chhiah te, a hmun chhunga lirthei hman man te, leh a dang dangte pawh Africa ram pawn a nih tawh chuan chhut vek ang che.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Khawvel chhimlama zin veivak duh tan hian thlawhtheihna leh thlenna duhthlan tur a tlem deuh a, hei hi tuipui leh tuipui inkara thlawhtheihna kalkawng tam tawk loh vang a ni.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Khawi airline mah hi khawvel chhimlam tlawh kualna atana kawng pawimawh tak tuipui pathum chunga khualzin phur kual thin an awm meuh lo a ni (SkyTeam phei hi chuan heti lamah hian khualzin a phur ngai lo).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Amaherawhchu Star Alliance hian South Pacific khawchhaklam, Santiago de Chile atanga Tahiti tih lohah chuan khualzin a phur kual thei vek a, heti lai hi chu LATAM Oneworld chanpual a ni.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: South Pacific leh South America khaw thlanglam tlawh tel duh lo tan he thlawhtheihna chauh lo pawh hi duhthlan tur a awm a ni (a hnuiah a enfiah theih).
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Kum 1994 khan Azerbaijan-a hnam chi khat Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh ho chuan Azeris lakah indona an lo puang tawh a ni.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Armenia puihnain mipui sawrkar thar a lo ding a.Amaherawhchu ram dang mai bakah Armenia takngial pawhin a ngaipawimawh hranpa lo a ni.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: He hmun chungchanga sawrkar nena inhnialbuaina chhuak hian Armenia leh Azerbaijan inkar a la tichhe chhunzawm zel a ni.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) hi kum zabi 17 laia district lar tak kha a ni a, Amsterdam-a Binnenstad hmun hualtu a ni.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: He district pumpui hian UNESCO World Heritage Site nihna a chelha, a chelh chhan ber chu a culture dangdai tak leh history hlutna riau a neih vang a ni a.He district-a leilung hi a ram puma hlutna nei sang berte zinga mi a ni.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre (Ram panga tihna) hi Italy-a Liguria hmuna awm Ruimaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza leh Monterosso, tui kama khaw lian vak lo panga sawina a ni.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: UNESCO World Heitage Site zingah an lang tel ve a ni.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Kum zabi tam tak kal ta atang tawh khan he hmuna cheng mipuite hian hmun rem lo tak takah uluk takin terrace an lo siam fur tawh a, tuipui bula tlang chhip chhengchhe ve tak tak thleng an lo siam tawh a ni.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: He hmun duhawm dangdai riauna pakhat chu tunlai hmasawnna leh changkanna hmuh tur awm lohna hi a ni ve tlat mai a.Kawng pawh awm ve thoin rel leh lawng te pawh awm ve tho mah se motor a tlan lut thei lo a ni.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Belgium leh Switzerland mite French tawng chi hrang hman hi France rama French tawng an hman nen a inang lo deuh a, amaherawhchu inanna chen a neih avangin tawng an inhrethiam tawn vek a ni.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: A bikin Belgium leh Switzerland-a number an chhiar dan hi France-a number chhiar dan nen a inanloh deuh bakah an lam dan a hrang deuh bawk a ni.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Heti chung hian French tawng hmang Belgian leh Swiss ho hian sikulah French tawng pangai hi an zir deuh vek avangin French tawng pangai kan hmanga number kan sawi a nih pawhin an hrethiam tlangpui a ni.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Khawvela hmun tam takah chuan kut vai lauh lauh hi inchibaina "hello" entirna chi khatah an ngai a ni.
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Amaherawhchu Malaysia hmun thenkhat, a bikin Malay ho awmna khuaah te chuan kut vai hi lo kal hnai tura inhriattirna ("come over" tihna) leh inkohna a ni a, chumi atan chauh chuan an hmang bawk a, hei hi khawthlang rama kutzungchal an taksa lama an tihchet nen hian inthuhmun reng a ni.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Heti ang bawk hian British mi Spain rama zin chuan inthlah dawna kut vai (kutphah a vaitu lam hawi si a vai) hi lo let leh rawh tihna amaw tiin a hresual ve thei bawk.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Auxiliary language hi tawng siam chawp emaw phuahchawp tiin a sawi theih a, mi tupawh tawng inhrethiam tawn lo tana siam niin, he tawng siam chawp hmang hian an inbe thei dawn a ni.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Lingua francas an tih nen hi chuan a inang chiah loa, heng hi chu tawng puitling ni sa, tawng dang hmang te nena inbiakpawhna tha zawk neih duhna vanga tawng hman ber lo ni ta hi an ni.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Khaw en lai phei chuan helai hmuna zinte hian khaw lum lutuk vangin tui awm lohnaah tui ni awm tak thla (mirage) an hmu fo thin a ni.
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Heng hi khualzin thenkhat chuan a tak emaw tiin tha leh tui hlu tak sengin an pan ta thin a, hei hi a hlauhawm thei hle a ni.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Thlaler lum ber pawh hi zanah chuan a vawt ve thei hle a.Kawrlum ken that loh phei chuan taksa lum zawng tla hniam vak (hypothermia) a thlen thei a ni.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: A bikin nipuiah rainforest paltlanga kal tum tan thosi laka inven that a pawimawh hle a ni.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Heng subtropical rainforest hi lirthei hmanga tlanpel ringawt tur tan pawh lirthei luh dawna kawngkhar hawn chhung ringawt pawhin thosi tam takin min zui lut chiam thei tih hriat a tha hle.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Sava hri, emaw a hming pangngai avian influanza hi, sava te leh hnute tui pe chi te'n an kai thei a ni.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Mihring kai hriat tur hi chu an tam lo viau a, mahse a kai tawh thenkhat chuan an la nain thihpui hial te pawh an awm a ni.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: A telve mi tam zawk hi ar vulhtu te an ni a, sava zirchiang tute tan pawh a hlauhthawnawm tho mai.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Norway-ah chuan lui leh ruam thuk tak tak, plateau-a rawn tawp hmuh tur a tam hle a ni.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Heng plateau te hi "vidde" tiin an sawi thin bawk a, a awmzia chu hmun zau tak inhawng huau, thing awm mang lohna leh khuaptu nei lo tihna a ni deuh ber.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Rogaland leh Adger-ah chuan "hei" tiin an sawi mai thin a, thing awm lohna hmun zau, heather pangparin a bawk chuk tihna a ni deuh ber.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Heng vur tlang (glaciers) vawt tak te hi an che hrut hrut thin a, tlang lam panin an tawlh thla thin bawk a ni.Hei hian vur khi te a siam a, vur leilawn lo insiam ve bawk te chuan hmuh a ti harsa thei hle bawk.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Vur puk bang leh chung te hi chim leh keh darh a ping mai thei an ni.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Vur tawlh chung sirah te hian vur tlang lian pui pui keh chhia a tla thut thei leh lum kual thei a awm thin a.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: India-a tlang ramte'n khualzin an ngah lai ber chu nipui lai hi a ni.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Amaherawhchu heng tlang ram te hian thlasikah hian mawina dangdai tak an nei ve bawk a, vur tam tak a tlak ve thin avangin intihhlimna atana vura tawlh te hi an uar hle a ni.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Airline tlem chauhin thihna avanga chuan man tlawm hi an ti tawh a, chhiattawhna avanga chawpchilh taka vuina a zin turte an tlawm hret thin.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Hetiang la ti thin te zingah hian Air Canada, Delta Airlines, Lufthansa (U.S emaw Canada atanga thlawk chhuak tur tan) leh WestJet te an tel a ni.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Heng ang zawng zawng ah hian, airline te hnenah phone kaltlangin i book nghal tur a ni.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
